$comment: lucide-react name -> reference glyph (tools/parity/reference-icons, named as in its index.json).
glyphs: the reference draws the same object. fallbacks: the reference has no equivalent, so the registry keeps the lucide drawing (fallback-glyphs.json) at the reference's house stroke.
files: per-file choices where the reference uses a different glyph for that context (drawer outlines, chip camera, slider arrows).
categoryIcons: icon names the API sends for categories -> reference category tiles (CategoryIcon).
Names ending in Icon (HeartIcon) or starting with Lucide (LucideHeart) resolve to their base name.
